function bindSpaceControls(c): void;

Defined in: experiments/earth-playground/space/wiring.ts:56

Binds the whole panel via four delegated scoped listeners on the shadow root: click (panel toggle, reopen, collapsible headers, data-action buttons), focusin/focusout (keyboard traversal temporarily expands a collapsed group while focus is inside), input (sliders), and change (checkboxes) — the last two both route to _handleInput. Delegation means a re-render doesn't lose handlers.

SpacePlayground
